sitNotifyBodyFocus: Get up and walk for 3 minutes. This focus session keeps counting.

breakEndBodyAuto: The next focus session starts by itself when you are at the computer
moodWhyDay: {hours, plural, one {# hour of focus today} other {# hours of focus today}}

focusTotalTip: Today's total focus time, sessions without a task included
timeThisTask: Time this task instead; the countdown goes on
help1: ⌃⌥H opens Hibi from any app; Esc closes it
help3: ↑↓ select a task: Space done · ↩ edit · F time · 1~4 quadrant · ⌘⌫ delete
help4: ⌘↑↓ moves the selected task to the tier above or below
help6: Double-click to edit, Enter saves, Esc discards; right-click for more
help7: Click a tag to filter; tasks added while filtering get that tag
help8: Auto-start, ending the session when you leave and the sitting reminder can all be changed in the settings
help9: Hover a task and click play to time it
help10: Every change is written to ~/todos.md at once; edits from elsewhere reload by themselves
autoStartTitle: Start focus by itself at the computer
autoStartNote: Starts with the length you picked last: at launch, when you come back after leaving, and when a break ends. After you press Stop, time at the computer still counts as focus: if you have not left {minutes} minutes later, a session starts that began at the stop; if you leave and come back, it starts when you are back. To not be timed, pause instead.
endOnAwayTitle: End the session when you leave
endOnAwayNote: Leaving counts as the break, and the task gets only the time before you left. A waiting break prompt closes too.
awayLabel: Minutes without input that count as leaving
awayNote: This long without keyboard or mouse input, or asleep this long, counts as leaving. Watching a video or reading without touching the computer also counts as leaving.
awayNoteActivity: This long without keyboard or mouse input, or asleep this long, counts as leaving. A playing video or a call does not; reading without touching the computer does.
awayNoteUnused: Not used while both settings above are off.
sitSettingNote: After you sit for the time below, a notification asks you to get up and walk for 3 minutes; the countdown goes on. 3 minutes without input counts as having got up and starts the time over.
sitStudy: In a study, a 5-minute walk every 30 minutes lowered both blood sugar and blood pressure; a walk every 60 minutes did not lower blood sugar.
activityNote: While a video plays or a call goes on, not touching the computer does not count as leaving or getting up. If you type when focus ends, the reminder waits for you to stop (3 minutes at most); in a call, for the call to end (1 hour at most). Hibi reads only system state: no screenshots, no content.
allOffNote: With all of these off, Hibi does not read the keyboard and mouse idle time.
promptDone: {minutes, plural, one {# minute, done.} other {# minutes, done.}}
promptStreak: {minutes} minutes of focus in a row, with no break
tipShort: Use the restroom, get some water, walk around.
tipMedium: Walk around, loosen your neck, shoulders and wrists, and look at something far away.
tipLong: Climb a few flights of stairs, or do 10 squats.
tipVeryLong: Too long without a break, so do not skip this one: climb a few flights of stairs, then do a set of push-ups.
